accepted.s: In 1906, which two organisations were established in Madras to promote Swadeshi activities?
o: A Swadeshi Store and a National School
A Bala Bharathi Samiti and a Swarajya Samiti
An Industrial Association and a Swadeshi League
A National College and a Young Men's Association
accepted.x: Madras had an Industrial Association to promote Swadeshi goods and a Swadeshi League in 1906.
accepted.tq: Identify the paired institutions associated with the same year and place.
accepted.sec: Swadeshi and national education institutions - founder, president, place  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Who toured Andhra to popularise Swadeshi activities in the early phase of the movement?
o: Mutnuri Krishna Rao and T. Prakasam
Gadicherla Harisarvottama Rao and J. Ramachandra Rao
Nyapathi Subbarao and K. Venkataramana Rao
Karanam Guneswara Rao and Kattiventi Perraju
accepted.x: Nyapathi Subbarao and K. Venkataramana Rao toured Andhra to popularise Swadeshi activities.
accepted.tq: Test the persons associated with propagation, not those associated with later institutions or trials.
accepted.sec: Swadeshi and national education institutions - founder, president, place  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the Andhra Jateeya Kalasala:
1. It was located at Machilipatnam.
2. It was founded in 1910.
3. Its foundation stone was laid by Bipin Chandra Pal in 1907.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The Andhra Jateeya Kalasala, also called Bandaru National College, was located at Machilipatnam, founded in 1910, and had its foundation stone laid by Bipin Chandra Pal in 1907.
accepted.tq: Separate the foundation year from the earlier foundation-stone ceremony.
accepted.sec: Swadeshi and national education institutions - founder, president, place  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Who was the president of the Andhra Jateeya Kalasala?
accepted.x: Nyapathi Subbarao was the president of the Andhra Jateeya Kalasala.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the president from the first principal and other education activists.
accepted.sec: Swadeshi and national education institutions - founder, president, place  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements regarding the first principal of the Andhra Jateeya Kalasala is correct?
o: Nyapathi Subbarao introduced weaving as a subject.
Karanam Guneswara Rao founded it at Rajahmundry.
Kattiventi Perraju served as its first principal.
Kompalle Hanumantha Rao introduced weaving as a subject.
accepted.x: Kompalle Hanumantha Rao, also referred to as Kompelli Hanumantha Rao, was the first principal and made weaving a subject.
accepted.tq: Use the person–office–achievement relationship to reject swapped roles.
accepted.sec: Swadeshi and national education institutions - founder, president, place  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer using the codes given below:

List-I (Institution)
a. Godavari Swadeshi Store
b. National School
c. Andhra Jateeya Kalasala

i. Ramachandrapuram
ii. Rajahmundry
iii. Machilipatnam

List-II (Place)
accepted.x: The Godavari Swadeshi Store was at Rajahmundry, the National School at Ramachandrapuram, and the Andhra Jateeya Kalasala at Machilipatnam.
accepted.tq: Start with the sure institution–place pair and eliminate codes containing a repeated or displaced location.
accepted.sec: Swadeshi and national education institutions - founder, president, place  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following statements about the National School at Ramachandrapuram is correct?
o: It was affiliated to the Andhra Jateeya Kalasala at Machilipatnam.
Kattiventi Perraju donated Rs. 1,000 and Guneswara Rao gave land worth Rs. 40,000.
It was inaugurated by Bipin Chandra Pal as the first national college.
Guneswara Rao donated Rs. 1,000 and Kattiventi Perraju gave land worth Rs. 40,000.
accepted.x: Guneswara Rao contributed Rs. 1,000, while Kattiventi Perraju provided land valued at Rs. 40,000. Nyapathi Subbarao inaugurated it as a true National School.
accepted.tq: Match each contributor with the correct amount and distinguish a school from a college.
accepted.sec: Swadeshi and national education institutions - founder, president, place  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which institution at Rajahmundry was inaugurated by Bipin Chandra Pal?
accepted.x: Bipin Chandra Pal inaugurated the Godavari Swadeshi Store at Rajahmundry in 1907.
accepted.tq: Distinguish an inaugurated Swadeshi store from the national education institutions.
accepted.sec: Swadeshi and national education institutions - founder, president, place  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The National School at Rajahmundry was affiliated to which body?
accepted.x: The Rajahmundry school was affiliated to the Bengal national education body.
accepted.tq: Identify the institutional affiliation rather than the place where the school was situated.
accepted.sec: Swadeshi and national education institutions - founder, president, place  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which event was inspired by Japan's victory over Russia in 1905?
o: The growth of interest in industrial training in Japan and works such as Japaniyam and Japan Charitra
The formation of the Young Men's Swarajya Samiti alone
The establishment of the Godavari Swadeshi Store at Rajahmundry
accepted.x: Japan's victory over Russia inspired many young Andhras to seek industrial training in Japan and influenced Munagala Raja, the play Japaniyam and Adipudi Somanatha Rao's Japan Charitra.
accepted.tq: Connect a historical cause with the several cultural and educational responses it produced.
accepted.sec: Swadeshi and national education institutions - founder, president, place  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which subjects formed the themes of Bipin Chandra Pal's two speeches at Kakinada?
accepted.x: At Kakinada, Pal delivered speeches on Vedanta and on Swadeshi-Swaraj.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between the actual speech themes and the broader programme associated with Pal.
accepted.sec: Bipin Chandra Pal's tour of Andhra - towns, year, organisers, hosts

accepted.s: Who welcomed Bipin Chandra Pal at Rajahmundry, where he delivered five lectures?
accepted.x: Gadicherla Harisarvottama Rao welcomed Pal at Rajahmundry, where Pal stayed at Madella Sourayya's house and delivered five lectures.
accepted.tq: Keep the welcoming person distinct from the organiser and the host at another town.
accepted.sec: Bipin Chandra Pal's tour of Andhra - towns, year, organisers, hosts

accepted.s: On which date and at which place did Bipin Chandra Pal deliver a speech specifically on national education during his Andhra tour?
accepted.x: Pal delivered a speech on national education at Rajahmundry on 23 April 1907.
accepted.tq: Combine the precise date with the town instead of relying only on the sequence of the tour.
accepted.sec: Bipin Chandra Pal's tour of Andhra - towns, year, organisers, hosts

accepted.s: Which pair of persons hosted Bipin Chandra Pal at Vijayawada?
o: Munagala Raja and Nayani Venkata Rangarao
Gadicherla Harisarvottama Rao and Madella Sourayya
Kattiventi Perraju and Karanam Guneswara Rao
Kompalle Hanumantha Rao and Brahmo Ramadasu Naidu
accepted.x: Munagala Raja and Nayani Venkata Rangarao hosted Pal at Vijayawada on 24 April 1907.
accepted.tq: Pair the town with its hosts while avoiding the host arrangements of Rajahmundry and Machilipatnam.
accepted.sec: Bipin Chandra Pal's tour of Andhra - towns, year, organisers, hosts

accepted.s: What was the title of Bipin Chandra Pal's final speech at Machilipatnam?
accepted.x: Pal delivered his final speech, titled Matru Murthi, at Machilipatnam on 27 April 1907.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the title of a speech from titles of seditious writings and books.
accepted.sec: Bipin Chandra Pal's tour of Andhra - towns, year, organisers, hosts

accepted.s: Which of the following best represents Bipin Chandra Pal's political message during his Andhra tour?
o: National schools were unnecessary if Swadeshi stores were established.
Swaraj was the goal, boycott was the weapon, and organisation had to reach the village level.
Swaraj could be achieved only through government employment and legislative petitions.
The movement should remain confined to major urban centres.
accepted.x: Pal presented Swaraj as the goal, boycott as the weapon, and stressed village-level organisation and national schools.
accepted.tq: Apply the stated programme to identify the option containing the complete and accurate set of principles.
accepted.sec: Bipin Chandra Pal's tour of Andhra - towns, year, organisers, hosts

accepted.s: Who started the Telugu weekly Swarajya in 1908?
accepted.x: Gadicherla Harisarvottama Rao started the Telugu weekly Swarajya in 1908.
accepted.tq: Match the publication with its founder rather than with a political organiser or student leader.
accepted.sec: Seditious writings and trials - author and sentence  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Gadicherla Harisarvottama Rao was sentenced to rigorous imprisonment for which period in the case arising from Viparita Buddhi?
accepted.x: His article Viparita Buddhi led to a sedition charge and a sentence of three years' rigorous imprisonment.
accepted.tq: Test the exact sentence length using closely spaced numerical alternatives.
accepted.sec: Seditious writings and trials - author and sentence  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following statements about the Rajahmundry college incident is correct?
o: The incident occurred at the National College in Machilipatnam in 1910.
The ban was imposed by T. Prakasam at Vijayawada.
Principal Mark Hunter banned Vandemataram badges and the slogan in April 1907.
Principal Mark Hunter encouraged students to wear Vandemataram badges during examinations.
accepted.x: Mark Hunter, principal of the Rajahmundry Arts and Teachers Training College, banned Vandemataram badges and the slogan in April 1907.
accepted.tq: Use the authority–institution–action combination to catch swapped persons and places.
accepted.sec: Rajahmundry college student incident  [APPSC]

accepted.s: What was the immediate action taken by Gadicherla Harisarvottama Rao in defiance of the Rajahmundry college authorities?
o: He founded the Godavari Swadeshi Store.
He organised a bomb attack on a railway train.
He delivered the final speech Matru Murthi.
He presented an address to Bipin Chandra Pal.
accepted.x: Gadicherla defied Principal Mark Hunter by presenting an address to Bipin Chandra Pal. J. Ramachandra Rao co-organised the action.
accepted.tq: Identify the specific act of defiance rather than a later or unrelated movement activity.
accepted.sec: Rajahmundry college student incident  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which consequence followed the Rajahmundry college Vandemataram incident?
o: The college was affiliated to the Bengal national education body.
All students were transferred to Machilipatnam.
138 students were debarred from examinations for two years.
accepted.x: A total of 138 students were debarred from examinations for two years after the incident.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the collective punishment imposed on students from the separate punishment imposed on Gadicherla.
accepted.sec: Rajahmundry college student incident  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Rajahmundry college incident of 1907 is historically significant because it marked:
o: The beginning of the Home Rule Movement in Andhra
The foundation of the Andhra Jateeya Kalasala in 1910
The first use of bombs in the Andhra movement
The active entry of Andhra students into India's freedom struggle
accepted.x: The incident marked the active entry of Andhra students into the freedom struggle.
accepted.tq: Identify the broader historical significance of a specific local incident.
accepted.sec: Rajahmundry college student incident  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which statement regarding the Kotappakonda riots is correct?
o: They occurred in February 1909 in Guntur, and 14 persons died.
They occurred in July 1907 in Kakinada, and 138 students were punished.
They occurred in April 1909 in Tenali, and the accused were released by T. Prakasam.
They occurred in April 1907 in Rajahmundry, and Pal presided over the meeting.
accepted.x: The Kotappakonda riots occurred in February 1909 in Guntur, and 14 persons died.
accepted.tq: Check the event against both its date and place, since the other options borrow details from neighbouring incidents.
accepted.sec: Kakinada riots, Kotappakonda riots, Tenali bomb case  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Who was sentenced to death in connection with the Kotappakonda riots?
accepted.x: Chinnapa, also known as Chennappa Reddy, was sentenced to death and was described as the only person in India sentenced to death in the Vandemataram movement.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the person sentenced from the accused and witness in the Tenali case.
accepted.sec: Kakinada riots, Kotappakonda riots, Tenali bomb case  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the Tenali bomb case:
1. It took place in April 1909.
2. The bomb was aimed at the Howrah passenger.
3. Y. Jagganna was a witness in the case.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The Tenali bomb case occurred in April 1909, involved a bomb aimed at the Howrah passenger, and had Y. Jagganna as a witness.
accepted.tq: Combine date, target and witness details to identify the complete set of correct statements.
accepted.sec: Kakinada riots, Kotappakonda riots, Tenali bomb case  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which set of persons was accused in the Tenali bomb case?
o: Chinnapa Reddy, Y. Jagganna and T. Prakasam
Gadicherla Harisarvottama Rao, J. Ramachandra Rao and Mark Hunter
Munagala Raja, Nayani Venkata Rangarao and Kattiventi Perraju
Chukkapalli Ramaiah, Lakkaraju Basavaiah and K. Venkatarayudu
accepted.x: The accused were Chukkapalli Ramaiah, Lakkaraju Basavaiah and K. Venkatarayudu.
accepted.tq: Separate the accused group from the witness and the lawyer associated with the case.
accepted.sec: Kakinada riots, Kotappakonda riots, Tenali bomb case  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Who secured the release of the accused in the Tenali bomb case?
accepted.x: T. Prakasam successfully secured the release of the accused in the Tenali bomb case.
accepted.tq: Match the legal outcome with the person who acted in that role.
accepted.sec: Kakinada riots, Kotappakonda riots, Tenali bomb case  [APPSC]

o: Munagala Raja, Nayani Venkata Rangarao and Kattiventi Perraju
Nyapathi Subbarao, K. Venkataramana Rao and Kompalle Hanumantha Rao
Tanguturi Prakasam, Panchumarti Ramachandra Rao and T. Prakasam
Chilukuri Veerabhadra Rao, Gante Lakshmanna and Unguturi Sriramulu
accepted.x: The founders were Chilukuri Veerabhadra Rao, Gante Lakshmanna and Unguturi Sriramulu.
accepted.tq: Distinguish founders from later members and from people connected with Pal's tour.
accepted.sec: Youth and student associations - town and year  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which pair consisted of members of the Bala Bharathi Samiti?
o: Chilukuri Veerabhadra Rao and Gante Lakshmanna
Tanguturi Prakasam and Panchumarti Ramachandra Rao
Munagala Raja and Nayani Venkata Rangarao
accepted.x: Tanguturi Prakasam and Panchumarti Ramachandra Rao were members of the Bala Bharathi Samiti; the other named founders were Chilukuri Veerabhadra Rao, Gante Lakshmanna and Unguturi Sriramulu.
accepted.tq: Separate the founders of an association from its listed members.

accepted.s: The Young Men's Swarajya Samiti was formed during which event?
o: Bipin Chandra Pal's visit to Machilipatnam
accepted.x: The Young Men's Swarajya Samiti was formed at Machilipatnam during Bipin Chandra Pal's visit in 1907.
accepted.tq: Link the association with the event during which it was formed, not merely with its town.

accepted.s: The second Andhra Students Conference was held in:
accepted.x: The second Andhra Students Conference was held at Machilipatnam in 1909.
accepted.tq: Test the exact year–place combination using adjacent movement dates as distractors.
